recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質裡（及破裂後散出至周圍）充滿大量 2–4 µm 的小圓形/卵圓形原蟲，每顆都有紫色的核與旁邊一條小棒狀的動基體（kinetoplast，箭頭），即為利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote）。
features: Macrophage with numerous small (2-4 um) oval intracytoplasmic organisms, some dispersed extracellularly
Each organism has a round purple nucleus and a separate small rod-shaped dark kinetoplast (arrows)
Pale blue organism cytoplasm without a surrounding clear capsule
Surrounding marrow cells include myeloid precursors and a plasmacytoid cell
Occasional red cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage containing numerous small, oval intracellular organisms, with some organisms dispersed in the adjacent background from ruptured cytoplasm. Each organism measures approximately 2-4 um and contains a round nucleus and a distinct, smaller rod-shaped kinetoplast. Surrounding hematopoietic precursors are present without other specific abnormalities. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes, diagnostic of visceral leishmaniasis in this HIV-coinfected patient with pancytopenia.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo/pseudocapsule and a single eccentric nucleus without a kinetoplast and are GMS/PAS positive.
Toxoplasma organisms are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and lack a kinetoplast.
Morphologically nearly identical with a kinetoplast, but T. cruzi favors cardiac/smooth muscle and epidemiology or PCR is needed to separate them.
Platelets and debris are granular and irregular without the consistent paired nucleus-kinetoplast structure.
